instruction:
Write back component classification parameters in the native Altium schematic `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\oscillator_core.SchDoc` instead of exporting CSV. In Altium Designer, add or update the user parameter `Classification` for each component, then save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\oscillator_classified.SchDoc`.

Classification requirements:
- `R42`, `R33`, `R39`, `R34`, `C1`, `C3`, and `L1` -> `Passive`
- `Q16` -> `Transistor`
- `V24` -> `Source`

Do not delete any existing parameter, and do not turn the task into an external classification table.
source: Local Altium example `Simulation Quick Start/6_Oscillator.SchDoc`; task restored toward native schematic parameter editing.
